question: Who recently assumed charge as the CEO of UIDAI while continuing as Additional Secretary in MeitY? (January 2025)
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhuvnesh Kumar.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Bhuvnesh Kumar, a 1995-batch IAS officer from the Uttar Pradesh cadre, assumed charge as CEO of UIDAI.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **He continues as Additional Secretary in the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY).**
 
• A gold medalist from NIT Kurukshetra, he has held key roles, including Joint Secretary in MeitY and Principal Secretary in UP's Animal Husbandry Department.
 
• His career spans diverse sectors like finance, MSME, sports, and technical education.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• **UIDAI**__

 __
 
• Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI) is responsible for issuing Aadhaar, a 12-digit unique identification number.
 
• Founded under the Aadhaar Act, 2016.
 
• Aims to provide a digital identity to residents of India.
 
 
 
• **MeitY**__
 
 
• Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology oversees digital initiatives in India, including UIDAI and the Digital India program.
